title: Preliminary baseline evaluation
summary: The fixed 25-question baseline and review packet are preserved. T-033 now owns the reproducible G2 evaluation harness.
evidence: Answerability decision matched expected behavior for 16 of 25 questions.
Citation rule satisfied for 25 of 25 questions.
Mean retrieval latency was 208.31 milliseconds and P95 was 771.87 milliseconds.
No production question records were created.
limitations: Human FFM scores remain useful evidence. Closing T-009 does not establish a production cutover threshold.
